privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: We collect only what a booking needs: your name, phone and, if you give it, your email. Hosts see your contact details only if their role allows it. Calendar feeds we share with Airbnb and Booking.com say only that dates are taken. The trip concierge sends your message and public listing data to our AI provider (DeepSeek), never your phone, email or bookings. Owners' AI keys see only what that owner's role permits, and every access is logged. Ask us to delete your account at any time.
